campaign_brief.objective: Launch the Rover Off-Roader, targeting adventurous individuals who want a dependable electric board for varied terrain exploration and fun.
campaign_brief.key_message: The Radboards Rover Off-Roader is your dependable partner for conquering varied Indian terrains and expanding your weekend adventures.

proof_points.claim: Built with deep treaded solid rubber tires for superior grip on dirt and grass.
Features two 350W hub motors, making it easy to scale slopes up to 10 degrees.
Designed to support a max load of 100 kg, ensuring robust performance.
Offers 8–10 km range per charge for extended fun.
Charges in just 150 minutes, minimising downtime.

campaign_brief.success_metric: Increase in product page views for Rover Off-Roader by 20% in the first month post-launch.

script.title: Radboards Rover: Built for Every Path

beats.line: Ever looked at that path less travelled and wished your ride could follow?
beats.on_screen: Rider stands at the edge of a paved road looking at an inviting dirt trail.

beats.line: Pavement ends. Gravel starts. Most boards stop. Not a Radboards Rover.
beats.on_screen: Quick cuts showing rough terrain: gravel, grass, small bumps. Then a shot of the Rover's rugged tires.

beats.line: This is the Rover Off-Roader. Built for more. Made to take on anything.
beats.on_screen: Dynamic reveal of the Rover Off-Roader, showcasing its robust design and off-road tires. Focus on the Radboards logo.

beats.line: Its deep treaded tyres grip dirt and grass. Twin 350W hub motors tackle slopes up to 10 degrees. Glide for 8 to 10 km on a single charge. It recharges in just 150 minutes. It holds up to 100 kg.
beats.on_screen: Scene 1: Close-up of Rover tires gripping gravel. Scene 2: Rover smoothly ascends a 10-degree incline. Scene 3: Rider enjoying a scenic ride on a dirt path. Scene 4: Graphic indicating '150 mins charging time'. Scene 5: Rider, confidently on the board.

beats.line: Find your next adventure. See the Rover at Radboards.in today.
beats.on_screen: Rider rides off into a picturesque, unpaved landscape. Then a clear call to action: 'Radboards.in' displayed prominently.

caption:
Beyond the pavement. The Radboards Rover Off-Roader conquers any path. ⛰️ Potholes, grass, dirt? No problem. With deep-treaded tires and twin 350W motors, it scales 10° slopes. Enjoy 8-10 km range, recharging in just 150 mins. Built tough for real adventures. Yours for ₹24,999.
Get ready to explore: radboards.in
*Range, speed, charge vary by conditions.
